title: Instrumental 8: Mixed Review
description: Synthesis of all seven instrumental contexts: tool / means, reflexive verbs, с (with), professions, transport, position prepositions, and 3rd-declension feminine + adverbial use.
descriptionRussian: Закрепление всех семи функций творительного падежа.
intro: Seven different things can put a noun in this case, and they range from cutting bread to being proud of your sister to sitting behind a desk. None of that variety reaches the ending. Whichever trigger fired, the form is the one from lessons 1 and 2. Find the trigger, apply the gender rule, done.
rules: Seven trigger families put a noun in the instrumental: tool / means (no prep), verbs taking instrumental directly (пользоваться, интересоваться, гордиться), с (with), profession (работать, быть, стать), transport (на + prep default; bare instr formal), position prepositions (за, под, над, перед, между), and 3rd-decl feminine (-ью) including adverbial use.
Identify the trigger first; then apply the gender-based ending: hard masc / neuter -ом, soft -ем, fem -а → -ой, fem -я → -ей, fem -ь → -ью.
The bare instrumental of time-of-day and season nouns serves as adverbs: ночью, утром, днём, вечером, летом, зимой, осенью, весной (recap from Lesson 7).
Once the trigger is named, the case is fixed. Distractors look similar (gen, dat, acc, prep) but mark different roles; only the instrumental answers Кем? Чем?.
examples: Антон работает врачом. (Anton works as a doctor.) Profession: работать кем.
Маша пьёт чай с молоком. (Masha drinks tea with milk.) С + accompaniment.
Лена едет на автобусе. (Lena is going by bus.) Transport: на + prep.
Кошка спит под стулом. (The cat sleeps under the chair.) Position preposition.
Маша гордится сестрой. (Masha is proud of her sister.) Reflexive verb.
Я работаю ночью. (I work at night.) Adverbial 3rd-decl instrumental from L7.

rows.label: Transport
cells: на + prep default; bare instr formal

items.hint: Recap from Lesson 7: 'at night' uses which form of ночь?
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 7: ночь is 3rd-decl feminine, instrumental -ью → ночью. The bare instrumental also serves as an adverb meaning 'at night.' Today's lesson synthesizes all seven instrumental triggers.

items.promptEnglish: Lena cuts bread with a knife.
items.hint: Trigger family: which one puts the tool in the instrumental?
items.explanation: Trigger: TOOL / MEANS (bare instrumental, no preposition). Нож → ножом. The bread (хлеб) is the direct object (acc); the knife is the means (instr). Two cases coexist in one sentence; each ending marks its own role.

items.promptEnglish: Masha is proud of her sister.
items.hint: Trigger family: гордиться takes its complement in which case?
items.explanation: Trigger: VERB TAKING INSTRUMENTAL (гордиться + instr). Сестра is feminine -а → -ой → сестрой. Like пользоваться and интересоваться, гордиться takes the instrumental directly with no preposition.

items.hint: Trigger family: с (with) takes which case?
items.explanation: Trigger: С + ACCOMPANIMENT. Молоко is neuter -о → -ом → молоком. С takes the instrumental for the 'with' meaning; the case ending follows the noun's gender.

items.hint: Trigger family: future-tense быть + profession takes which case?
items.explanation: Trigger: PROFESSION (быть future + кем). Инженер is masc consonant + -ом → инженером. The same instrumental appears with работать, with был / будет, and with стать.

items.hint: Trigger family: how does Sonya travel? Conversational form is на + prep.
items.explanation: Trigger: TRANSPORT. The conversational default is 'на + prepositional': на трамвае. Soft -й takes -е in the prep.

blanks: Я часто гуляю _____ в парке. (I (m) often walk in the park in the evening.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Recap from Lesson 7: the bare instrumental of вечер serves as an adverb 'in the evening.' Masculine consonant + -ом → вечером.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The child eats soup with a spoon.
errorCorrection.explanation: A tool takes the BARE instrumental, with no preposition: ест ложкой. С (with) marks accompaniment, not the instrument of an action, so 'ест с ложкой' is wrong. Compare 'идёт с другом' (с + a companion) with 'пишет ручкой' (a bare-instrumental tool).

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: In winter the cat sleeps under the blanket.
errorCorrection.explanation: Под takes the instrumental for STATIC location: спит под одеялом (neuter -о + -ом). Спать is a stative verb (no movement), so the instrumental is required. Под одеяло (accusative) would mark motion under the blanket ('забрался под одеяло', crawled under the blanket), which pairs with a motion verb. With спит, the static под одеялом is correct.

errorCorrection.sentence: Мой младший брат очень интересуется физику.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: My younger brother is very interested in physics.
errorCorrection.explanation: Интересоваться governs the instrumental: интересоваться чем. Физика is feminine -а, so the instrumental is физикой. Физику is the accusative, which a learner uses by treating 'interested in physics' as a direct object, but Russian uses the instrumental. The verbs пользоваться, интересоваться, and гордиться all take the bare instrumental.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Lena cuts bread with a knife.
minimalPairs.explanation: Tool / means triggers the bare instrumental: ножом. The nominative нож would only mark a subject ('Нож острый.' / 'The knife is sharp.'), not the means of cutting.
С (with) triggers the instrumental: другом. The dative другу appears after к (к другу = to a friend) for motion, not after с for accompaniment.

patternRecognition.question: What trigger puts врачом in the instrumental?
patternRecognition.explanation: Работать + profession takes the instrumental: работать кем. The verb is the trigger; врачом marks Anton's role, not a tool or accompaniment.

patternRecognition.question: What trigger puts молоком in the instrumental?
patternRecognition.explanation: С (with) puts the noun in the instrumental for accompaniment. The tea is the direct object; the milk is what comes WITH the tea. Trigger: с + accompaniment.

patternRecognition.question: What trigger puts ночью in the instrumental?
patternRecognition.explanation: 'At night' uses the bare instrumental of ночь as an adverb: ночью. Ночь is 3rd-declension feminine, so the ending is -ью. Adverbial time-of-day forms (утром, днём, вечером, ночью) all use the bare instrumental.

patternRecognition.question: What trigger puts стулом in the instrumental?
patternRecognition.explanation: Под for static location takes the instrumental: под стулом. Спит is stative; the cat is not moving, just sleeping in place. Trigger: position preposition with stative verb.

reviewVocab.definition: instrumental case (seven trigger families: tool, reflexive verbs, с, profession, transport, position prepositions, and 3rd-decl / adverbial)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Антон работает врачом' слово 'врачом' стоит в творительном падеже.

reviewVocab.definition: context (the trigger or construction that requires the instrumental)
reviewVocab.example: Контекст определяет, какой триггер творительного падежа работает в предложении.

reviewVocab.definition: mastery (the goal of this track; once the seven triggers feel automatic, the instrumental is settled)
reviewVocab.example: После этого урока творительный падеж требует только мастерства, а не догадок.
